name: tou_away_bank_writes_once_1395
description: Issue #1395 (the Away mirror of #1393): the house is Away on a hot day with a 16:15 peak (bank window opens 12:21). Before the fix, each cycle in the window told the thermostat the 80 F Away setback and then the 77 F split-delta bank target in the same second, and re-sent 77 F every 5 minutes; now each cycle tells it 77 F once and nothing is sent between cycles.

assertions.reason: First classified cycle inside the Away pre-cool window (opened 12:21; no classification existed before 14:00): the bank target 77 F once, no 80 F setback band first (issue #1395).
Between cycles nothing is written: the bank write cancels the 5-minute follow-up, and the 5-minute bank check leaves a thermostat that already holds 77 F in cool alone (issue #1395).
A later cycle inside the window re-asserts the bank target once (issue #1395).

verdict.summary: While pre-cooling an Away house for a peak, each cycle tells the thermostat the bank target once
verdict.observed_behavior: One set_temperature (77 F) per cycle and none between cycles; before the fix each cycle wrote 80 F then 77 F in the same second and 77 F was re-sent every 5 minutes.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: no brief flick to the setback value, and one cloud write per check instead of two.
